name: OKC_ARTICLE_ADOPTIONS
description: This table stores the adoption details of a global clause  version in any given local operating unit. This table has rows for local operating units only.  This stores rows for clause adoptions as AVAILABLE, LOCALIZED and ADOPTED.

columns.name: GLOBAL_ARTICLE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to OKC_ARTICLE_VERSIONS. This references the Global Clause Version which was used for adoption at a Local Operating Unit.

columns.name: LOCAL_ARTICLE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to OKC_ARTICLE_VERSIONS. If a clause has been localized in the local operating unit, this information is stored. It is null for clause adopted 'as-is'

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ADOPTION_TYPE
columns.description: Adoption Type of the Clause. Localized, Adopted . Foreign Key to FND_LOOKUPS of lookup type OKC_ARTICLE_ADOPTIONS.

columns.name: LOCAL_ORG_ID
columns.description: Refers to the operating unit in which the global clause was adopted as is or localized.

columns.name: ADOPTION_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the Adoption of the Clause in the local org e.g. Not Approved, Pending, Approved. Foreign Key to FND_LOOKUPS of Lookup Type OKC_ARTICLE_STATUS.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
